title: rename_columns: rename one or more columns
description: Rename one or more columns using an old-name to new-name mapping. The original column values are unchanged; only the column header is updated. Use this to clarify column names, apply business labels, or prepare data for export.

parameters.name: mapping
parameters.description: A dictionary mapping old column names (keys) to new column names (values). All old column names must exist in the dataset.

rag_note: All source (old) column names must exist in the dataset. The validator will reject unknown source names. Only use this step when the user explicitly asks to rename or relabel columns.
